title: 7 day return policy
text: Non-customized products can be returned within 7 days if unused and packaging is complete. Customer service should first confirm order number, product status, and reason.

title: VIP customer service policy
text: High value customers should receive priority handling, warmer tone, and optional manual follow-up. Do not promise discounts without a real promotion or manager approval.

title: Stock and product recommendation
text: When recommending products, only use currently available products from the CRM product list. If no product matches, say that no reliable match was found and offer to collect more requirements.

title: Complaint handling
text: For complaints, first acknowledge the customer's feeling, then ask for key information, provide a concrete next step, and avoid blaming the customer.

title: Shipping delay handling
text: If the issue is delayed shipping, customer service should check logistics status, give an estimated update window, and offer follow-up notification.
